alert.name: ECSServiceAlarm
alert.summary: CloudWatch alarm fired for ECS service checkout

tool_errors: logs: logs: /ecs/checkout: An error occurred (ResourceNotFoundException) when calling the FilterLogEvents operation: The specified log group does not exist.

root_cause.hypothesis: Alarm likely triggered by anomalously low CPU utilization (~0.004%) on checkout service, not by task/deployment failure — task count matches desired (2/2), no pending/failed deployments, memory normal (~59%). One deployment shown in-flight despite empty RECENT DEPLOYS list is unexplained; could be stale/mid-flight deploy or traffic drop causing idle CPU. No logs provided to confirm root cause (e.g. upstream traffic loss, LB misroute, or app stuck idle vs crash-loop).
evidence: tasks_running == tasks_desired (2/2), tasks_pending=0 — no scheduling/placement failure
cpu_utilization_pct ~0.0045% — near-zero, abnormal for active service
deployments_in_flight=1 but RECENT DEPLOYS list empty — inconsistent/incomplete evidence
LOGS field empty — no app-level error evidence
ruled_out: Task crash-loop or scheduling failure (running == desired, no pending)

proposal.reasoning: Tasks 2/2 running, no pending/failed deployments, memory normal (~59%). Only anomaly: CPU ~0.004% and one in-flight deployment not shown in RECENT DEPLOYS. No logs to confirm root cause (idle app, traffic/LB misroute, or stuck deploy). Insufficient signal to pick a safe automated action.
proposal.expected_effect: Human investigates low-CPU cause and unexplained in-flight deployment before any service-impacting action taken.

reasons: Action is inert or advisory; no approval required.
